Participated in the development of Solidity smart contracts with bridging logic. RelayBridge is a cross-chain system that acts as a bridge to transfer tokens and assets between two different blockchain platforms.
RelayBridge provides blockchain interoperability by connecting different blockchain networks. Thus, it allows users to experience the distinctive features of each network and the additional benefits of a chain of nodes.
When a user initiates a token transfer from chain A to chain B, the assets are first sent to a relay node on chain A. The relay node then sends the same number of tokens to chain B and maintains liquidity at destination B.

Position:

Moreinfo:
The main part of my IT career was in France. After some Java internship, got my first Data Science job in 2015. In 2021-2022 I had a role of AI Team Lead, delivering various AI applications to the clients, with hands-on experience as well as team and people management activities.

Originally from Ukraine, i lived in Paris in 2011-2019 and in Berlin in 2019-2020. This gave me a good experience in working with European clients and a lot of foreign languages practice (especially English and French). In 2021 i moved back to Ukraine.

I also like teaching: in 2018-19 gave several 1-week introductory courses on Machine Learning / Deep Learning to the students of Pierre-Marie Curie university in Paris.

Interested in designing/building/deploying Machine Learning systems. A mix of a solid mathematical background (theoretical physics MSc in Ukraine and France) and a software engineering education make me relevant for a wide range of Data Science/Machine Learning/Deep Learning positions, from prototyping ideas to deploying models in production.

Looking For:
Machine Learning/Deep Learning/Computer Vision projects, with models running in production (not just prototypes). Perfect case: "bridge" between Data Science and Data Engineering.

Want to be a part of a strong Machine Learning/Data Engineering team, being able to constantly learn and grow. 

Most interested in domains like computer vision, medical, transport, "social good", ecology. Less interested in marketing, retail.

Social aspect is very important to me: knowing that the results of my work help to improve people's lives.

Agile methodology is preferred, with very clear communication. 

In case of an international collaboration, the company could also benefit from my knowledge of foreign languages and almost 10 years of observing the culture/mentality of Western Europe.

Highlights:
Industrialized an existing scikit-learn prototype using Spark (Scala) to deploy a system for predictive maintenance of trains. 15 binary models predicting the probability of failure of each type of physical equipment of 200 Paris regional trains. This allows French railways to detect potential failures and proactively replace a train, which is more cost-effective than fixing a train failing during a passenger circulation.

Deployed an image classification system, based on satellite images (100 megapixel, 1 meter resolution) from Sentinel satellite of EU Copernicus program. System is used for ice segmentation in the Arctic Ocean, improving safety of ships navigation.

Was teaching 4 introductory 1-week courses on Machine Learning / Deep Learning to the students of Pierre-Marie Curie university in Paris.

Created 2-million node graph of transportation network (roads, railways) of 100% territory of France, using OpenStreetMap data. This map-matching system, via both LeafletJS visualization and aggregated geo data, allowed mobile operators to improve the accuracy of their geo-statistics solutions.

In a team of 4, built a hackathon winning Flask/Leaflet web application: animation of map-matched trajectories on the transport network of France.

Built a centralized system for storing all marketing costs (25 channels/vendors) of a NYSE public company. Reports based on this data are more stable, allowing Business Intelligence, Strategy, Marketing teams to plan marketing campaigns more accurately.

Participated in French Robotics Cup 2016.

Position:
Applied Scientist

Moreinfo:
I am an Applied Scientist with around 9 years of experience in prototyping/building various NLP and multi-modal models. At my current job and previous positions my tasks included:
• Building/experimenting with Vision Language models (ALBEF) of different sizes to introduce usage of visual
elements into the slot carryover model used within home assistant system
• Leading a team of 5 scientists in building/experimenting with multilingual distilled models with various techniques (logit matching, tinyBERT, teacher logit annealing, etc.) to improve upon prod models (results published at EMNLP and KDD). Distilled models are used at various building blocks of the home assistant system
responsible for ASR, NLU, conversation and etc.
• Implementation of a framework for distilling student models from teacher models of transformer architecture on various tasks in a multi-GPU setup
• Prototyping/experimenting with machine translation for automatic language and feature bootstrapping in home assistant system (results published at NAACL)

Finding trigger events in news
• Classifying emotions in customer emails
• Knowledge extraction from handbooks
• Classification of texts into market segments and sentiment classes
• User-intent classification for automating FAQs
• Confidentiality level classification of internal and external documents
• Named Entity Recognition and relation extraction for different use cases (persons, organizations, conductor-
performer-title relations from radio broadcast descriptions, investment targets from annual reports, etc.)
• Prototyping near duplicate detection in real time with streams (Using Elasticsearch as storage)
• Building content based ranking algorithm for concepts within texts that was used for ad selection (250%
improvement in click through rate)
• Implementation of plugins for Elasticsearch and query components for Solr, generic scraping tool for forums
• Development of custom libraries and refactoring of legacy code, making visualizations with Kibana

Position:
Computer Vision Researcher

Moreinfo:
First of all, it is worth mentioning that I started my ML journey from the famous ML course and DL specialization by Andrew Ng. Furthermore, I had a deep dive into the Computer Vision area with UMich CV for the DL class.
	To make my dream of being a CV Engineer come true, I have tried myself in various Kaggle competitions. Working on "Flower Classification with TPUs.", "RSNA Pneumonia Detection" and "Generative Dog Images" I have learned how to organize my code in such a way to make iterative updates easily. I had acquainted with modern image classification (ResNeXt, MobileNet, ViT, and NFNet), object detection (Faster-RCNN, FPN, YOLO, DETR), segmentation  (U-Net, Mask-RCNN), and generative model (VAE, DCGAN, WGAN) architectures. To interpret models' behavior and understand what features models are learning during training, I have applied such techniques as Saliency Maps and GradCAM. Moreover, Kaggle has provided me with the opportunity to practice with GPU and TPU training.
	Later, during the data analysis coursework at the university, all that practical knowledge came in handy. My groupmate and I developed the model to cope with the task of product matching. This project taught me how to work in a team.
	Additionally, I have experience with frontend and backend development, which I have gained working on a simple blog at university. I have also studied Git, and some DevOps stuff, including creating multi-stage Docker builds for the Node app, setting up Traefik as reverse-proxy, and developing a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions.

I’m a professional content marketer focusing on creating a content strategy for IT companies. My main responsibilities are:

- analyze a website using a crawler

- test all links

Skilled in collecting and utilizing diverse Agile metrics using tools such as PERF, Azure DevOps, Jira, and XLS.

In this role, I envision working closely with cross-functional teams, ensuring a seamless and efficient Agile process that fosters a culture of transparency and adaptability. I am excited about the prospect of guiding and mentoring teams to achieve their full potential, while facilitating Scrum ceremonies and implementing Agile best practices to drive successful project outcomes.

In summary, my achievements showcase effective project leadership, commitment to knowledge sharing, valuable Agile certifications, and adeptness in dual roles. Position:
Business Analyst

Moreinfo:
Proactive and dedicated Business Analyst with over 5 years of experience in different domains, organizations and project methodologies.  

Specializing in the healthcare domain (mostly LIMS of different complexity), but also have experience in consulting and retail. 

My skillset allows me to handle tasks that are done by Product Managers, Project Managers and Business analysts, but my key passion is Business Analysis. 

I performed BA activities on projects with different technologies and team composition, starting from discoveries to project delivery. 

My strongest areas are stakeholder management, requirements analysis and definition of design, requirements elicitation and fostering of stakeholder collaboration. 

I enjoy organizing and facilitating workshops, where stakeholder share ideas and where the requirements conflicts are resolved. 

When it comes to communication with the development team, my favorite part is collaboration on feature design (in a broad sense) and the polishing of requirements which would not be possible without the development team's input. 

In nearly half of my project, I have shared some Project Management responsibilities in terms of project scope management, conflicts management and overall client expectations management.

Looking For:
Capable of working on challenging projects in situations of uncertainty - more than 10 Discovery projects have trained me in it. 

During the last year, I had lots of teaching and mentoring experience, and I would like to exercise in these skills further.

I am looking for the opportunity to work as BA Lead/Mentor within current BA-related processes or with creating BA-related processes from scratch based on the needs of the organization.

- have managed to reach the BA goals on the project despite the need to mentor junior BAs; 
- helped the client realize the core problems, determine business priorities and shape the vision of the project before making risky investments; 
- was assigned to the projects on the most "rough" stage of its development, where I had to organize BA infrastructure, activities, processes, and schedule, as well as do my job dealing with high level of uncertainty that is so common for such stages.
- inspired tens of associates/trainee to explore BA profession

I worked as Scrum master, Kanban master and as Agile coach.

- events became more efficient and the team started to challenge Product Owner more on the value and tasks priorities, which positively reflected on the team's working effectiveness and positive feedback from stakeholders
- other team became fully self-managed and mature
- its performance grown significantly, for last 2 years Cycle time was stable between 1-3 days, when complexity of tasks grown, team optimised its work a lot and keep working on continuous improvements

-  the team became confident and more efficient
- were built new processes that fit the purpose and enforce the organisation to use them, by that collaboration with other domains improved, became more predictable and less stressful
- also, this team performance improved, Cycle time decreased from 6-8 days to 2-3 days.
- Rework and waste were also reduced or eliminated
- coaching and mentoring for my colleagues which positively affected their teams results

I have developed high-quality software for high-scale production systems using best-in-class tools and technologies, was effectively leading teams of engineers growing an outstanding working culture. Currently working as CTO for a US-based product company where I have built a great team of developers and am leading a transition from microservices to a serverless architecture. This transition allowed us to dramatically reduce the cost of development and infrastructure paving the ground for future development. In my previous job, I was architecting and leading the development of a proprietary infrastructure management system that was in charge of scaling, deploying, and monitoring all stateless services on over 18 000 EC2 instances serving over 80 billion requests daily across multiple regions (US, EU). It provided a high-quality UI and a unified GraphQL API for various UI clients, CLIs, and other tools providing data from EC2, S3, ELB, CloudWatch, Consul, RabbitMQ, GitLab API, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Graphana, Artifactory, and various internal APIs and databases with live updates via web socket subscriptions (including AWS events like EC2 instance lifecycle). Encapsulated all domain-specific operations reducing DevOps involvement dramatically. Combined all infrastructure management under one UI enabling a single context for developers as a complete application lifecycle management platform: from deployment to test/staging/production environments to autoscaling and monitoring. It lowered a barrier to entry for new developers in a company, time spent on application management, allowing automated continuous delivery, and much more. Now multiple teams in the company are contributing features to the platform enriching it with their specific functionality. Participated in a migration process to Kubernetes instead of an inefficient proprietary deployment mechanism.

Position:
AWS DevOps / Solutions Architect

Moreinfo:
I have been working as a software developer (TypeScript, Node.js) for the last 6 years. My latest role was a Senior Backend Developer in a British startup where I was responsible for designing, developing and monitoring a set of microservices hosted on AWS. 
Working in cross-functional teams and constantly being engaged in DevOps activities, I have realised that dealing with infrastructure is what drives me the most. Now I am looking for the next career shift: becoming AWS DevOps and Solutions Architect.

I am holding several AWS certifications:
- Certified Solutions Architect - Professional  – Oct 2022
- Certified Solutions Architect - Associate – Dec 2020
- Certified Developer - Associate – Aug 2019 

Total experience with AWS: 5 years

Examples of tasks I can perform:
- set-up 3-tier architecture (Route53 -> ALB / API Gateway -> Lambda / ECS -> RDS / DynamoDB / ElastiCache ...)
- create infrastructure for ETL jobs (i.e. S3 -> SNS -> SQS -> Lambda -> EFS)
- write IaC with AWS CDK (TypeScript), Troposphere (Python),   CloudFormation, Terraform, Serverless
- package Node.js / Python app as a Docker container and deploy to the cloud
- set up CI/CD pipelines using CodeBuild/CodeDeploy or GitHub actions
- configure network connection in/inter VPC
- manage multi-account and multi-region AWS environments
- create application monitoring dashboards in AWS or DataDog 
- perform on-call duties resolving application alerts

I do admit that I am still missing some DevOps skills: Linux administration, web servers configs, Kubernetes, Chef, Puppet. I am working on filling these gaps and ready to learn more tools required for the position.

Looking For:
Would like to become a part of a company specialising in DevOps services and consulting, preferably AWS Partner. Also, consider product companies where I can combine AWS management (80%) with Node.js development (20%).

- Passed AWS Solutions Architect-Professional certification

Certified cloud solutions architect with experience in design, implementation and maintenance of system infrastructure and networks of national and international levels. Programming abilities used for prototyping (e.g. CNI drivers for Kubernetes), development of microservices, APIs creation and automation tasks.

    System architecture design and implementation

    Building high load and high availability solutions based on top of bare metal and cloud resources
    CI/CD design and implementation

Highlights:

Furthermore, I increased network throughput 3x fold by integrating DPDK with OpenvSwitch.
 	
2. I designed, developed, and obtained buy-in from the stakeholders on the zero-downtime deployment architecture as well as tooling needed to be used. Moreover, I participated in creating IaC using Ansible. I was also the main driver behind creating complex multi-step CI/CD solution with visualization that could be used by both developers and customer’s upper management.

3. I created scalable CI/CD pipelines with immutable agents on internal infrastructure, stored every piece of infrastructure as code and designed the solution to be cost efficient and easy to use. Furthermore, I provided clearer future vision for the customer.

5. I designed and developed solution for providing additional services over VPN that included ad-blocking, parental control, on-the-fly image compression and anti-virus checks. I also increased possible numbers of users per VPN server tenfold by introducing AAA caching. I re-wrote parts of API from Perl to PHP during a migration and created new API for authentication purposes.
